title: Design System: AI RAM Guard website

headline.purpose: Recurring platform, preview and help headings.

instruction.purpose: Numbered installation steps; help text uses a slightly looser line-height.

motion.name: anchor-scroll
motion.purpose: Anchor navigation; prefers-reduced-motion: reduce switches to auto. No transition-duration tokens exist.

components.name: Language selector
components.description: Native buttons with aria-pressed selection; runtime language switching belongs to site/app.js.
components.html: <nav class="ds-language" aria-label="Sprog / language"><button type="button" aria-pressed="true">Dansk</button><button type="button" aria-pressed="false">English</button></nav>
components.css: .ds-language{display:flex;gap:4px}.ds-language button{font-family:"Segoe UI",-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,Arial,sans-serif;cursor:pointer;border:0;background:transparent;color:var(--muted,#b5afbf);padding:10px;border-radius:6px;font-size:14px}.ds-language button[aria-pressed=true]{background:var(--surface,#1c1a23);color:var(--ink,#f3effa)}.ds-language button:hover{color:#fff}.ds-primary:focus-visible,.ds-secondary:focus-visible,.ds-language button:focus-visible,.ds-disclosure summary:focus-visible,.ds-disclosure a:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--link,#ed92f1);outline-offset:5px}@media(max-width:640px){.ds-language button{padding:9px 7px;font-size:13px}}

components.css: .ds-disclosure{font-family:"Segoe UI",-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,Arial,sans-serif;border-block:1px solid var(--line,#393342);color:var(--ink,#f3effa)}.ds-disclosure summary{cursor:pointer;padding-block:20px;font-size:16px;line-height:1.5;font-weight:500}.ds-disclosure>div{padding:0 24px 16px 0;max-width:75ch}.ds-disclosure p{color:var(--muted,#b5afbf);font-size:15px;line-height:1.7;margin:0 0 14px}.ds-disclosure a{color:var(--link,#ed92f1);text-underline-offset:4px}.ds-disclosure a:hover{text-decoration-thickness:2px}.ds-primary:focus-visible,.ds-secondary:focus-visible,.ds-language button:focus-visible,.ds-disclosure summary:focus-visible,.ds-disclosure a:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--link,#ed92f1);outline-offset:5px}@media(max-width:640px){.ds-disclosure summary{font-size:15px}}

narrative.northStar: AI RAM Guard's existing app identity
narrative.overview:
This records the shipped website, not the whole native app. It inherits the existing logo, Byens IT attribution, dark neutral canvas and magenta action color. The confirmed direction is an extension of that identity; no replacement brand was created.

The implementation uses clear text hierarchy, open spacing and thin dividers. The download page composition and installation story remain in the surface brief rather than becoming requirements for every future screen.
keyCharacteristics: Dark neutral canvas with one magenta action accent.
Readable utility typography and restrained rounded controls.
Flat, divider-led groups with visible focus treatment.

rules.name: The Action Accent Rule
rules.body: Use the brand fill for the primary action; supporting links use the lighter link color.

rules.name: The Flat Surface Rule
rules.body: Preserve flat resting surfaces and use the existing neutral border and tone vocabulary to separate groups.

dos: Do preserve the supplied logo, AI RAM Guard identity and Byens IT attribution.
Do use the Action Accent Rule and visible keyboard focus.
Do retain the website's stacked mobile behavior and proportionally scaled imagery.
Do keep supporting text legible against the dark canvas.
donts: Don't turn this page's column count or content order into a system-wide layout rule.
Don't infer website tokens from colors embedded inside the app screenshot.
Don't promote the inherited display-font exception into a reusable display rule.
